summary: A large, symmetrical three-story building with a hollow rectangular footprint enclosing a central open courtyard. The exterior features pale yellow walls with horizontal wooden bands separating the floors, accented by white vertical pillars. The roof is made of red brick and loops entirely around the courtyard. Inside the courtyard, there is a grass floor with diagonal lines of light-emitting blocks and a small central pavilion topped with a matching brick roof.

shape.symmetry: Bilateral on both X and Z axes

materials.name: quartz
materials.role: vertical pillars and spaced perimeter base blocks

materials.name: brick
materials.role: roofing over the main building and central pavilion

rebuild_hints: Start by laying out a 29x29 square footprint, leaving a large hollow square in the center for the courtyard.
Build the walls up to three stories, alternating the primary wall material with wood planks to create horizontal floor dividers.
Add white pillars on the exterior walls to provide depth and structural framing.
Construct the pitched brick roof only over the outer rectangular ring, leaving the central courtyard completely open to the sky.
In the courtyard, place diagonal lines of light-emitting blocks embedded in the grass and build a small central pavilion with a matching brick roof.
uncertainties: The exact block palette for the pale yellow walls is uncertain; it could be sandstone, end stone, or smooth sandstone.
The exact material of the white blocks is uncertain; it could be quartz, white concrete, or smooth quartz.
The purpose of the floating blocks directly above the central pavilion is unclear.
